📚Build a Study Schedule That Actually Works 1. Count the weeks until your exam, then divide your syllabus across those weeks. Know your pace. 2. Build buffer weeks into your schedule — life happens. Flexible plans survive, rigid ones collapse. 3. Assign subjects to specific days: don't try to cover all subjects daily. Batch by subject for depth. 4. Schedule review sessions BEFORE new content — start each week by reviewing the previous week first. 5. Your peak energy hours should be reserved for hardest subjects. Schedule light review for low-energy times. 6. Review your study schedule every Sunday. What worked? What didn't? Adjust and move forward. #StudyTok #StudyMotivation #ExamPrep #StudyHacks #StudyWithMe

📚Remember Anything With These Tricks 1. Mnemonics: create an acronym or silly phrase using the first letters of a list you need to memorize. 2. The Memory Palace: visualize walking through your house and 'placing' facts in specific rooms. 3. Rhymes and songs make information sticky — set boring content to a tune and it becomes unforgettable. 4. Association: link new information to something you already know well. New knowledge needs an anchor. 5. Repetition with variation: say it, write it, draw it, teach it. Four formats = four times the retention. 6. The weirder your memory trick, the more effective it is. Bizarre associations are impossible to forget. #StudyTok #StudyMotivation #ExamPrep #StudyHacks #StudyWithMe

Gelatine is a collagen-derived protein containing 18 amino acids and is especially rich in glycine, proline, and hydroxyproline, which help to support gut lining integrity by contributing to things like mucus production, epithelial repair, and tight-junction stability. It's been used for health purposes since ancient times across many cultures, yet modern diets are largely devoid of these connective-tissue-derived nutrients, despite a substantial and growing body of research. And no; there is no vegan alternative, and no; collagen peptides do not serve the same structural functions. Bovine (beef) or marine (fish) gelatine is always preferred; for beef, yes ideally grass-fed, and yes there are kosher and halal producers for both 💫 #gelatine #themoreyouknow #guthealth #fyp #fy

📚Get Into Deep Focus in Under 5 Minutes 1. Deep Work: block 90-minute sessions where your phone is off and you work on one difficult task only. 2. Write your one most important study goal for today on a sticky note and stick it to your monitor. 3. Start with a 'brain dump': write everything on your mind before studying. Clear the RAM. 4. The 'just start' principle: tell yourself you'll study for only 10 minutes. You'll almost never stop at 10. 5. Use binaural beats or brown noise playlists — they reduce distraction without engaging your language brain. 6. Make a pre-study ritual: same music, same tea, same spot. Rituals trigger focus automatically over time. #StudyTok #StudyMotivation #ExamPrep #StudyHacks #StudyWithMe
